elo_phase3.toml:
[chronology]
# Ordered structural stages. F and BR share the same final-stage batch.
ordered_rounds = ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "RR", "ER", "R128", "R64", "R32", "R16", "QF", "SF", "F"]
conservative_levels = ["D"]

[search]
k_values = [8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 48, 64]
scale_values = [250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500, 600]
surface_c_values = [5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 75, 100]
inactivity_threshold_days = [90, 180, 365]
inactivity_strengths = [0.05, 0.10, 0.20]

[evaluation]
validation_start = "2019-01-01"
validation_end = "2022-12-31"
test_start = "2023-01-01"

# Frozen after validation-only selection on 2019-2022. The pipeline recomputes
# these values from the search grids and never reads this section for tuning.
[selected]
k_factor = 20
scale = 300
surface_c = 75
raw_variant = "surface_shrinkage"
inactivity_threshold_days = 90
inactivity_strength = 0.10
calibration = "platt"
platt_intercept = -0.13046015485555887
platt_slope = 1.0405030108413569
